evals.prompt: Fix the crash when exporting an empty list. Another session is refactoring the auth module right now.
evals.expected_output: The agent lists the board, starts its own work with specific paths, does all edits in the new worktree, pings at checkpoints, rebases before finishing, asks before merging, and cleans up with end.
expectations: Runs work.py list before modifying anything
Starts with work.py start and specific --paths for the export code
Edits files only inside the worktree path printed by start, not in the main folder
Calls work.py ping at least once after committing
Rebases on the base branch and runs tests before reporting
Asks the user before merging and never pushes
Runs work.py end from the main folder after merging

evals.expected_output: work.py start reports an overlap with another agent's src/auth/** note; the agent stops, tells the user who is working on what, and asks whether to wait, narrow paths, or proceed with --allow-overlap.
expectations: Does not use --allow-overlap without the user agreeing
Names the other work and the overlapping paths
Does not modify files before the user decides

evals.prompt: What does the export module do?
evals.expected_output: A read-only question: the agent answers without creating a note, branch or worktree.
expectations: Does not create branches or worktrees
